entries.title: Cut LLM turns in MCP interactions by 75%+
entries.summary: Tura is a tool that dramatically reduces the number of LLM calls needed for Model Context Protocol interactions, cutting them by over 75%. This directly addresses a major cost and latency pain point for developers building LLM-powered applications.

entries.title: The whole of PyTorch on one page
entries.summary: A comprehensive visual guide mapping out PyTorch's entire ecosystem and concepts on a single page. Essential reference material for developers working with deep learning frameworks.

entries.title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash: Better, faster, at a quarter of the cost
entries.summary: Microsoft released an improved code generation model that matches or exceeds previous performance while being 4x cheaper and faster. A significant upgrade for developers using AI for code generation.

entries.title: Search over the Visual World: off-the-shelf VLMs beat video embeddings
entries.summary: Research showing that vision language models outperform specialized video embedding methods for visual search tasks. Validates using existing VLMs for video understanding rather than custom embeddings.

entries.title: Show HN: ExtractBench, an open-source schema extraction benchmark
entries.summary: An open benchmark for evaluating structured data extraction from unstructured text using LLMs. Critical for developers building information extraction pipelines to measure and compare model performance.

entries.title: Show HN: Webstractor – Pay-as-You-Go Web Data API for AI Agents
entries.summary: A web scraping API specifically designed for AI agents to fetch and process web data without managing infrastructure. Simplifies data collection for agent-based applications.

entries.title: Show HN: Pickle – token efficient AI agent browser with policy-gated actions
entries.summary: A browser automation tool optimized for token efficiency and constrained action spaces, designed specifically for AI agents. Reduces API costs when building agents that need web interaction.

entries.title: Can Claude Code in a loop improve an enterprise AI agent with $10,745 of budget?
entries.summary: A practical case study exploring agentic code improvement loops with detailed budget analysis. Real-world insights into implementing self-improving coding agents at scale.
